Access

        

          
          User
        

        

        
Recorded against your name, not this PC, so it follows you to any machine you sign in on. An Administrator can change it in Admin → Users.

        

          Access isn't set up. Every tier is open to anyone using this vault.
          Switch to Administrator, which will not ask you for a password, then set
          both passwords below to turn the gate on.
        

        

          
Passwords

          

            
            
          

        

        

        
        

          Locked out? The passwords are SHA-256 hashes in
          zSystem/auth.json in the vault. Delete that file in Obsidian
          or in SharePoint and moving up a tier above stops asking for a password,
          the same as a vault that was never set up. Move yourself to Administrator,
          then set both passwords again. Anyone who can be locked out already has the
          vault access needed to undo it.
